title: Capsule Protocol Policy and Registry Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned Capsule Protocol response/header policy and registry metadata for RFC 9297.
planned_changes:
- Add Capsule Protocol policy helpers for CONNECT-only HTTP/3 use, allowed response status, no-content restrictions, and malformed-message mapping.
- Add Capsule-Protocol structured-field Boolean parsing, false/non-Boolean absence behavior, unknown-parameter ignoring, intermediary processing, and recommended emission helpers.
- Add Capsule-Protocol field-name and Capsule Type registry constants and reservation helpers.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the HTTP/3 package build, focused Capsule Protocol policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and broad-suite instability classification before commit.
out_of_scope: HTTP/1.x Capsule Protocol connection start policy.
completion_notes: The RFC 9297 Capsule Protocol policy and registry slice is implemented above the runtime adapter boundary.
